[LFAC.8.2] The compiler generates a canonical `.proto`
definition for each schema declaration. The generated
`.proto` is the structural shape of fact instances of
that schema for any cross-boundary use: persistence to
disk by storage adapters, recording in event-trace
artefacts per [LFST.8.10], hypothetical wire transport,
debug inspection, code generation for integrator type
stubs.
